objective: Test one information-changing joint posture/support/stop update from the frozen Stage264 identity after Phase60 scalar one-update rejection.

source.policy_contract: 93D observation to lower12+waist3 15D action; frozen Stage250 deployment semantics
source.resume: fresh source plus zero-output LoRA; no Phase60 candidate is continued

hypothesis: A single PPO update whose rollout contains a clock-aligned start, cruise, deceleration and terminal hold can improve moving signed-pitch tails without sacrificing actual support or the state delivered to the fixed stationary deployment backend.
principal_change_from_phase60: State/event coverage, not a reward-weight sweep: the rollout grows from 0.48 s constant-motion fragments to one complete 10.24 s event.

training.adapter: zero-output rank-4 alpha-4 LoRA on actor and critic dense paths
training.checkpoint_policy: one shared source and one final candidate; no intermediate checkpoint

evaluation.interpretation: deterministic paired local gate, not independent statistical evidence

deployment_truth_boundary.candidate_effect: main locomotion actor can change walking posture and stop-entry state but does not replace the fixed stationary actor
deployment_truth_boundary.required_after_local_pass: exact LoRA merge, ONNX parity, then one-shot official physical gates with the fixed stationary backend

stop: If any local gate fails, reject this candidate and do not extend it to five updates, export promotion, or official-gate claims. If it passes, export and run physical gates before any further training.
